project_name.justification: The text repeatedly refers to the project of interest as the Atlantic Nickel Project. For example: "First Atlantic Nickel Corp. (TSXV: FAN) (OTCQB: FANCF) (FSE: P21) is a Canadian mineral exploration company developing the 100%-owned Atlantic Nickel Project..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified multiple times, for example: "First Atlantic Nickel Corp. (TSXV: FAN) (OTCQB: FANCF) (FSE: P21) ("First Atlantic" or the "Company") is pleased to announce..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, First Atlantic Nickel Corp., is identified in the text: "Adrian Smith, CEO of First Atlantic, provided an update on the company's recent progress and future plans..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company acquired a 100% interest in the RPM-South claims, which are part of the Atlantic Nickel Project. "The Company entered into an asset purchase agreement dated December 11, 2024 (the "Purchase Agreement”) with a group of arm’s length parties (the “Vendors”), whereby the Vendors agreed to sell to the Company a 100% interest in and to the Claims." The claims are part of the project: "The Claims are situated immediately south of the recent discovery at the RPM Zone... which is part of the 30 kilometer nickel trend within the Atlantic Nickel project".

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly described as a nickel project: "developing the 100%-owned Atlantic Nickel Project, a large-scale nickel deposit strategically located near existing infrastructure in Newfoundland, Canada."

verified_article_link.justification: No verifiable article URL was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The text mentions payments in dollars ('$') and the acquiring company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange, a Canadian exchange, implying the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD). For example: "The Company has agreed to pay cash consideration of $20,000..." and "The Company's common shares trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol 'FAN'..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The value is from the acquisition of the RPM-South claims, which are part of the Atlantic Nickel Project. "The Company has agreed to pay cash consideration of $20,000 and issue 750,000 common shares to the Vendors". The separate $5,000 cash payment for the Atlantis Project was ignored as it is not the project of interest.

share_payments_raw.justification: A raw monetary value for the share payment was not provided. The payment was described in terms of number of shares and price per share, which are captured in other fields.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text provides the components of the payment ($20,000 cash and 750,000 shares at a deemed price) but does not state a single combined value for the transaction.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The value is from the acquisition of the RPM-South claims. "The Company has agreed to pay cash consideration of $20,000 and issue 750,000 common shares to the Vendors at a deemed price of $0.1425 per share". The separate issuance of 4,000,000 shares for the Atlantis Project was ignored as it is not the project of interest.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: Share warrants were not mentioned as part of the transaction terms for the RPM-South claims.

option_payments_raw.justification: Options were not mentioned as part of the transaction terms for the RPM-South claims.

issued_share_price.justification: The deemed price per share for the RPM-South claims acquisition is explicitly stated: "The Company has agreed to pay cash consideration of $20,000 and issue 750,000 common shares to the Vendors at a deemed price of $0.1425 per share".

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: There is no mention of an exploration commitment in meters as part of the acquisition agreement for the RPM-South claims.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: There is no mention of a monetary exploration commitment as part of the acquisition agreement for the RPM-South claims.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The acquired RPM-South claims are subject to a 2% NSR retained by the seller. The rules state to capture NSRs retained by the seller. "The Claims are subject to a 2% NSR royalty, with the Company retaining the right to buy back half the royalty (1% NSR) for $1M at any time prior to the commencement of commercial production at the property."

coverage_area_raw.justification: No specific area in hectares or km2 was provided for the Atlantic Nickel Project or the acquired RPM-South claims. The text mentions the RPM-South acquisition consists of '12 mineral claims' but gives no area. The 13,675 hectares mentioned in the text refers to the separate Atlantis Project and was therefore ignored.

coverage_area_unit.justification: No specific area in hectares or km2 was provided for the Atlantic Nickel Project or the acquired RPM-South claims.

resource_size.justification: The text explicitly states that the company does not have reserves on its properties: "Furthermore, the Company currently has no reserves on any of its properties. As a result, there can be no assurance that such forward-looking statements will prove to be accurate..."

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The company's ticker and exchange are stated multiple times in the required format, for example: "First Atlantic Nickel Corp. (TSXV: FAN) (OTCQB: FANCF) (FSE: P21)..."
